applications.name: Tantrum
applications.description: When the Defender is Struck by a basic attack, they gain a Tantrum Charge. When the Defender is knocked down, all Tantrum Charges are removed and each deals a burst of Physical Damage equal to 10% of the Defender's Attack to the Attacker. While the Defender has a Concussion, Disorient, Enervate, or [k=glossary/taunt]Taunt[/k] Debuff, all Tantrum Charges are removed without causing damage, and the Defender cannot gain Tantrum Charges.
applications.rawDescription: When the Defender is Struck by a basic attack, they gain a Tantrum Charge. When the Defender is knocked down, all Tantrum Charges are removed and each deals a burst of Physical Damage equal to {1}% of the Defender's Attack to the Attacker. While the Defender has a Concussion, Disorient, Enervate, or [k=glossary/taunt]Taunt[/k] Debuff, all Tantrum Charges are removed without causing damage, and the Defender cannot gain Tantrum Charges.

applications.name: Combo Party - 2
applications.description: The Attacker gains an indefinite +500 [k=glossary/cruelty]Cruelty[/k] Buff for every 10 hits in their Combo Meter. If their Combo Meter is set to 0 when struck, all Cruelty Buffs are removed, each dealing 40% of the Defender's Attack as a burst of Direct Damage.
applications.rawDescription: The Attacker gains an indefinite +{1} [k=glossary/cruelty]Cruelty[/k] Buff for every {2} hits in their Combo Meter. If their Combo Meter is set to 0 when struck, all Cruelty Buffs are removed, each dealing {0}% of the Defender's Attack as a burst of Direct Damage.

applications.description: The Defender has indefinite Protection, reducing all damage received by 50%. This goes onto cooldown for 15 seconds when knocked down.
